mn72:16.1: evaṃ vimuttacitto pana bho gotama bhikkhu kuhiṃ upapajjatīti?
mn72:16.3: tena hi bho gotama na upapajjatīti?
mn72:16.4: na upapajjatīti kho vaccha na upeti.
mn72:16.5: tena hi bho gotama upapajjatīti ca na ca upapajjatīti?
mn72:16.6: upapajjati ca na ca upapajjatīti kho vaccha na upeti.
mn72:16.7: tena hi bho gotama neva upapajjati na nūpapajjatīti?
mn72:16.8: neva upapajjati na nūpapajjatīti kho vaccha na upetīti.
mn72:17.1: evaṃ vimuttacitto pana bho gotama bhikkhu kuhiṃ upapajjatīti iti puṭṭho samāno ‘upapajjatīti kho vaccha na upetī’ti vadesi.
mn72:17.2: tena hi bho gotama na upapajjatī’ti iti puṭṭho samāno ‘na upapajjatīti kho vaccha na upetī’ti vadesi.
mn72:17.3: tena hi bho gotama upapajjati ca na ca upapajjatīti iti puṭṭho samāno ‘upapajjati ca na ca upapajjatīti kho vaccha na upetī’ti vadesi.
mn72:17.4: tena hi bho gotama neva upapajjati na nūpapajjatīti iti puṭṭho samāno ‘neva upapajjati, na nūpapajjatīti kho vaccha na upetī’ti vadesi.
mn72:17.5: etthāhaṃ bho gotama aññāṇamāpādiṃ, ettha sammohamāpādiṃ.
mn72:17.6: yāpi me esā bhoto gotamassa purimena kathāsallāpena ahu pasādamattā, sāpi me etarahi antarahitāti.
mn72:18.1: alaṃ hi te vaccha aññāṇāya, alaṃ sammohāya.
mn72:18.2: gambhīrohāyaṃ vaccha dhammo duddaso duranubodho santo paṇīto atakkāvacaro nipuṇo paṇḍitavedanīyo.
mn72:18.3: so tayā dujjāno aññadiṭṭhikena aññakhantikena aññarucikena aññatrayogena aññatthācariyakena.

mn72:19.2: sace te purato aggi jaleyya, jāneyyāsi tvaṃ

mn72:19.8: sace maṃ bho gotama evaṃ puccheyya
mn72:19.9: ‘yo te ayaṃ purato aggi jalati, ayaṃ aggi kiṃ paṭicca jalatī’ti. evaṃ puṭṭho ahaṃ bho gotama evaṃ byākareyyaṃ.
mn72:19.10: ‘yo me ayaṃ purato aggi jalati, ayaṃ aggi tiṇakaṭṭhupādānaṃ paṭicca jalatīti.
mn72:19.11: sace te vaccha purato so aggi nibbāyeyya, jāneyyāsi tvaṃ

mn72:19.15: sace pana taṃ vaccha evaṃ puccheyya
mn72:19.16: ‘yo te ayaṃ purato aggi nibbuto so aggi ito katamaṃ disaṃ gato,
mn72:19.17: puratthimaṃ vā pacchimaṃ vā uttaraṃ vā dakkhiṇaṃ vāti. evaṃ puṭṭho tvaṃ vaccha kinti byākareyyāsīti?
mn72:19.18: na upeti bho gotama. yaṃ hi so bho gotama aggi tiṇakaṭṭhupādānaṃ paṭicca ajali tassa ca pariyādānā aññassa ca anupahārā anāhāro nibbuto’teva saṅkhaṃ gacchatī’ti.
